explanation.description: Safe static explanation, never raw provider, filesystem or token errors.

ExecutionHost.description: Host facts are supplied by the authenticated runtime, never client claims.

rank.description: One-based final shared retrieval order; never a fabricated source ID.

capabilities.description: Optional capabilities: absence at the server does not reject a peer.

required_capabilities.description: Required capabilities fail closed, including unknown names.

capabilities.description: Intersection of requested (optional and required) and supported features.

resolution.description: Absent when retention removed the governed version payload.

complete.description: All selected-source/materialization checks passed without known deficits. This is not a claim that lexical retrieval found every relevant source.

degraded.description: Fixed internal degradation codes, allowlisted by the public adapter.

sequence.description: Indexed memory sequence, not the session event sequence.

truncated.description: Shared retrieval exhausted a candidate, result, byte or time bound.

ResultValue.description: Typed outcomes never reinterpret pending/partial/unknown as success.

oneOf.description: Resolve the original durable command; do not invent a replacement ID.

description: Schema root bundles canonical definitions; this object is never a wire frame.
